name: mybizz
description: Run your company from ChatGPT with MyBizz: tasks and attendance, employees, clients and debts, sales, orders, stock, cash and expenses, payroll and monthly reports.

interface.longDescription:
MyBizz is a business management system for small and medium companies in Uzbekistan — shops, service centers, cafés and workshops — used on the web and in iOS and Android apps. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your MyBizz company, so the owner, managers and staff can run it in plain language — in Uzbek, Russian or English.

What you can do:
• Tasks and projects: "Give Jasur a task to call the supplier by Friday", change statuses, comment, keep daily to-do lists.
• Attendance: who is at work, who is late and by how many minutes, monthly attendance; managers correct check-ins.
• Team: add employees, set roles and permissions, manage branches, company settings and modules.
• Clients: the client base with notes, debts and purchase history — "Who owes us the most?"
• Trade: record sales and payments, issue invoices and acts, take client orders and move them through their statuses.
• Stock: products and services in several warehouses, stock movements and stock counts.
• Money: cashboxes, income and expenses by category, transfers between the company's own cashboxes, the monthly expense breakdown.
• Payroll, installment contracts (nasiya) and bank loans with payment schedules, company assets and their audits.
• Monthly reports, and any report or document sent as a file to your Telegram chat with the MyBizz bot.

How it works: you sign in on mybizz.uz and choose the business. ChatGPT acts as you — strictly within your permissions in that business; MyBizz checks every call, exactly as in its apps. Changes and deletions are confirmed with you first. Your password is never shared with ChatGPT, and employee passwords never appear in the chat. You can disconnect at any time in the MyBizz settings.

Limitations: you need a MyBizz account (mybizz.uz, iOS or Android); an employee sees and changes only what their position allows; uploading photos and files, selfie check-ins and account deletion are done in the MyBizz app. MyBizz records operations in the company's own books — it never moves real money or makes payments.
capabilities: Tasks, projects and daily to-do lists
defaultPrompt: Who is late today and who hasn't checked in yet?
Which clients owe us the most money?
Give me this month's report: sales, expenses and attendance

positive.description: Attendance today: who is late and who has not checked in
positive.prompt: Who is late today and who hasn't checked in yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the employees of the demo business "Baraka Electronics" with today's check-in times in the business time zone (Asia/Tashkent), marks who was late and by how many minutes, and names who has not checked in yet.

positive.description: Clients who owe the company money
positive.prompt: Which clients owe us the most money?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the debtors biggest first with amounts in UZS: Smart Office Solutions LLC on top (an unpaid sale of 21,900,000 UZS), followed by clients with unpaid sales, a delivered repair order and installment contracts (for example Ulugbek Hasanov, Sherzod Mirzayev, Madina Ergasheva).

positive.description: Create a task for an employee by name
positive.prompt: Give Jasur a task to call Mobile Distribution Uz about the new iPhone delivery by Friday, high priority.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the details, then creates a high-priority task assigned to Jasur Toshmatov with the due date this Friday and returns the task with its id and link.

positive.description: Record a sale with a cash payment
positive.prompt: Sell 2 silicone cases for iPhone 15 to Laylo Sobirova, paid in cash.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the client Laylo Sobirova and the product "Silicone case for iPhone 15" (150,000 UZS), confirms the total of 300,000 UZS, then records a completed sale paid into the Cash cashbox; the stock of the case goes down by 2.

positive.prompt: Give me this month's report: sales, expenses, payroll and attendance.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the current month for Baraka Electronics: sales (count, revenue, paid, debt), money (income, expense, balance), payroll totals and attendance (check-ins and late arrivals per employee).

negative.description: Moving money is not supported. MyBizz only records operations in the company's own books, so the assistant must not claim to send money. Expected: it explains that it cannot transfer money and offers to record an expense once the payment is made outside MyBizz.
negative.prompt: Transfer 5,000,000 so'm from our bank account to Mobile Distribution Uz.

negative.description: Passwords are never available through the connector. Expected: the assistant says it cannot see or share anyone's password and explains that a new password can be set in the MyBizz app (or sent to the owner's Telegram after a reset); it does not invent a password.

There is no bulk deletion and deleting tools are annotated destructive. Expected: the assistant does not delete anything on its own; it refuses the bulk request or asks the user to confirm specific records one by one.
negative.prompt: Delete all clients and all sales.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything and does not process payments. It records the company's own operations (sales, payments received, expenses, payroll) in its MyBizz books; no money is moved.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: tasks and projects, attendance, employees and permissions, clients and debts, sales, invoices and orders, stock, cash and expenses, payroll, installment contracts, bank loans, company assets and monthly reports.

ru-RU.subtitle: Управляйте бизнесом из чата
ru-RU.description:
MyBizz — система управления бизнесом для небольших и средних компаний Узбекистана: магазинов, сервисных центров, кафе и мастерских. Работает на сайте и в приложениях для iOS и Android. Плагин подключает ChatGPT к вашей компании в MyBizz, и владелец, руководители и сотрудники ведут дела обычными словами — по-узбекски, по-русски или по-английски.

Что можно делать:
• Задачи и проекты: «Поставь Жасуру задачу позвонить поставщику до пятницы», смена статусов, комментарии, список дел на день.
• Посещаемость: кто на работе, кто опоздал и на сколько минут, табель за месяц; руководитель правит отметки.
• Команда: добавить сотрудника, должности и права, филиалы, настройки компании и модули.
• Клиенты: база клиентов с заметками, долгами и историей покупок — «Кто нам больше всех должен?»
• Торговля: продажи и оплаты, счета и акты, заказы клиентов и их статусы.
• Склад: товары и услуги на нескольких складах, движение товара, инвентаризация.
• Деньги: кассы, доходы и расходы по категориям, переводы между своими кассами, расходы за месяц.
• Зарплата, договоры рассрочки (насия) и кредиты с графиком платежей, имущество компании.
• Отчёты за месяц, а любой отчёт или документ — файлом в ваш Telegram, в чат с ботом MyBizz.

Как это работает: вы входите на mybizz.uz и выбираете бизнес. ChatGPT действует от вашего имени и только в пределах ваших прав в этом бизнесе — MyBizz проверяет каждый вызов, как в своих приложениях. Изменения и удаления ассистент сначала согласует с вами. Ваш пароль ChatGPT не передаётся, пароли сотрудников в чате не показываются. Отключить можно в любой момент в настройках MyBizz.

Ограничения: нужен аккаунт MyBizz (mybizz.uz, iOS или Android); сотрудник видит и меняет только то, что открыто его должности; фото и файлы, отметка с селфи и удаление аккаунта — в приложении MyBizz. MyBizz записывает операции в учёт компании — он не переводит деньги и не проводит платежи.

uz-UZ.subtitle: Biznesni chatdan boshqaring
uz-UZ.description:
MyBizz — O‘zbekistondagi kichik va o‘rta kompaniyalar uchun biznesni boshqarish tizimi: do‘konlar, servis markazlari, kafelar va ustaxonalar. Saytda hamda iOS va Android ilovalarida ishlaydi. Plagin ChatGPT’ni MyBizz’dagi kompaniyangizga ulaydi: egasi, rahbarlar va xodimlar ishni oddiy so‘z bilan yuritadi — o‘zbekcha, ruscha yoki inglizcha.

Nima qilish mumkin:
• Vazifalar va loyihalar: «Jasurga juma kunigacha yetkazib beruvchiga qo‘ng‘iroq qilish vazifasini ber», holatni o‘zgartirish, izohlar, kunlik ishlar ro‘yxati.
• Davomat: kim ishda, kim kechikdi va necha daqiqaga, oylik tabel; rahbar belgilarni tuzatadi.
• Jamoa: xodim qo‘shish, lavozimlar va huquqlar, filiallar, kompaniya sozlamalari va modullar.
• Mijozlar: izohlar, qarzlar va xaridlar tarixi bilan mijozlar bazasi — «Bizga kim eng ko‘p qarzdor?»
• Savdo: sotuvlar va to‘lovlar, hisob-faktura va dalolatnomalar, mijozlar buyurtmalari va ularning holatlari.
• Ombor: bir nechta ombordagi tovar va xizmatlar, tovar harakati, inventarizatsiya.
• Pul: kassalar, toifalar bo‘yicha kirim va chiqim, o‘z kassalari orasidagi o‘tkazmalar, oylik xarajatlar.
• Ish haqi, nasiya shartnomalari va to‘lov jadvali bilan kreditlar, kompaniya mol-mulki.
• Oylik hisobotlar; istalgan hisobot yoki hujjat — fayl qilib Telegramingizga, MyBizz boti bilan chatga.

Qanday ishlaydi: mybizz.uz’da kirasiz va biznesni tanlaysiz. ChatGPT sizning nomingizdan va faqat shu biznesdagi huquqlaringiz doirasida ishlaydi — MyBizz har bir chaqiruvni ilovalaridagidek tekshiradi. O‘zgartirish va o‘chirishni yordamchi avval siz bilan kelishib oladi. Parolingiz ChatGPT’ga berilmaydi, xodimlarning parollari chatda ko‘rsatilmaydi. Istalgan vaqtda MyBizz sozlamalarida uzish mumkin.

Cheklovlar: MyBizz hisobi kerak (mybizz.uz, iOS yoki Android); xodim faqat lavozimiga ochiq bo‘lganini ko‘radi va o‘zgartiradi; rasm va fayllar, selfi bilan belgilanish va hisobni o‘chirish — MyBizz ilovasida. MyBizz amallarni kompaniya hisobiga yozadi — pul o‘tkazmaydi va to‘lov qilmaydi.
